text:
maria: FYI - spotted an SDK parity bug between our Python SDK and the new Rust sample app for embeddings + rerank. Python returns 2048-d vectors, Rust returns 1536 for the same model and input. Also rerank results are reordered in Rust.

devon: same exact model string? batching?

maria: yep, `redwood-embed-xl`, single input, no batching helpers. Printed lengths immediately after the call.

paul: can you dump raw response bodies + response headers (x-request-id, any x-rw-* headers)?

maria: Python resp shows embedding length 2048. Rust resp body shows embedding length 1536 and header `X-Model-Variant: compact-1`. Rust response id `req_rs_0a1b`. Python `req_py_z9x8`.

igor: server has a compact variant (1536) that we route to on fallback. Why would your request land there? Did the client retry and lose a model-pin header?

maria: aha — the Rust retry middleware resends without copying custom headers (we set `x-rw-model-version` for pinning). Python keeps it. So retry hit a different pool serving compact embeddings.

devon: rerank ordering?

maria: Rust sample builds a HashMap<id,score> and then iterates to produce the final list. HashMap iteration order isn't stable, so items shuffled even though scores match.

paul: action items: (1) fix retry to clone all headers (x-rw-*) in Rust client; (2) change sample to preserve server order (Vec or keep index).

igor: I'll open a P0 ticket and a patch. Also adding a regression test comparing dims between Python and Rust for canonical inputs and asserting `X-Model-Variant` header parity.

sdk-ci-bot: created RW-ENG-SDK-1287 assigned to @igor.

lydia: bumping priority. customers mixing SDKs could get silent mismatches.

maria: local quick fix: updated retry middleware to clone headers and switched HashMap->Vec in sample app. Re-tested: both SDKs now return 2048 and rerank order matches. New ids `req_rs_fix001` and `req_py_fix002`.

devon: great — please add a note to sample README and devex guide about header retention during retries and stable ordering for rerank outputs.

maria: will do. thanks everyone for quick help. :thumbsup:
